    Document QnA > Document AI QnA > Usage > Leverage Document QnA
    cite: https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna#usage
### Leverage Document QnA

The examples below show how to interact with a PDF document using natural language.

**QnA with a PDF Url**

Be sure the URL is **public** and accessible by our API.

**Python**

**V2**

```python
import os
from mistralai.client import Mistral

api_key = os.environ["MISTRAL_API_KEY"]
model = "mistral-small-latest"

client = Mistral(api_key=api_key)

messages = [
    {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": "what is the last sentence in the document"
            },
            {
                "type": "document_url",
                "document_url": "https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.04770"
            }
        ]
    }
]

chat_response = client.chat.complete(
    model=model,
    messages=messages
)
```

**QnA with a Base64 Encoded PDF**

You can perform QnA with any PDF by encoding them in base64 and sending them as part of the chat completion request.

**Python**

**V1**

**QnA with a Base64 Encoded PDF**

You can perform QnA with any PDF by encoding them in base64 and sending them as part of the chat completion request.

**Python**

**V2**


```python
import base64
import os
from mistralai.client import Mistral

api_key = os.environ["MISTRAL_API_KEY"]
model = "mistral-small-latest"

client = Mistral(api_key=api_key)

def encode_pdf(pdf_path):
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as pdf_file:
        return base64.b64encode(pdf_file.read()).decode('utf-8')

pdf_path = "path_to_your_pdf.pdf"
base64_pdf = encode_pdf(pdf_path)

messages = [
    {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": "what is the last sentence in the document"
            },
            {
                "type": "document_url",
                "document_url": f"data:application/pdf;base64,{base64_pdf}"
            }
        ]
    }
]

chat_response = client.chat.complete(
    model=model,
    messages=messages
)
```

**QnA with an Uploaded PDF**

You can also upload a PDF file in our Cloud and get the QnA results from the uploaded PDF by retrieving a signed url. Document QnA is under the umbrela OCR, the method for uploading and handling files will hence be the same.

content.text:
The context limit for the model used by Document QnA (`mistral-small-latest`, i.e., Mistral Small 4) is **256,000 tokens**.
[Context window](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations#context-window)

The 308 kB PDF is expensive because Document QnA sends the entire base64-encoded document in the prompt; base64 expands raw bytes by about 33 %, and PDF text is tokenized at roughly 1 token per ~0.4 bytes, so 308 kB raw → ~410 kB base64 → ~321 k prompt tokens, all counted against the 256 k limit.
[Leverage Document QnA](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna#usage)
